# Talent.com Multi-Country Job Listings Scraper

Talent.com runs a separate job site for each of 78 countries, aggregating millions of listings worldwide. This actor searches a specific country's site by keyword and location — or pulls full detail for job URLs you already have — so you get genuinely local results instead of a US search that happens to match a foreign-sounding place name.

## What this actor does

- Two modes: `search` (browse and filter listings) and `byJobUrls` (full detail for specific job URLs)
- Targets any of Talent.com's 78 country sites, so a location like "London" resolves to the UK when `country` is set to `uk`, not the US town of the same name
- Filters search results by radius, date posted, job type, remote-only and Quick Apply availability, and sorts by relevance or recency
- Pulls full description, formatted salary and posting/expiry dates from a job's own JobPosting data when fetching by URL
- Omits any field Talent.com didn't display for that job — no empty strings or nulls in the output

## Output per job

- `recordType` — `"job"` for a search result, `"jobDetail"` for a `byJobUrls` result
- `jobId`, `jobUrl`
- `title`, `company`, `location`
- `salary` — formatted as shown on Talent.com (search mode) or built from structured salary data (byJobUrls mode)
- `employmentType` — e.g. Full-time, Part-time, Contract
- `postedAgo` — relative posting time, search mode only
- `datePosted`, `validThrough` — ISO dates, byJobUrls mode only
- `description`, `descriptionSnippet` — byJobUrls mode only
- `country` — the Talent.com country site searched, omitted when it's the United States default
- `keyword`, `searchLocation`, `page` — the search filters that produced this record, search mode only

## Input

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | string | `search` | `search` (browse/filter) or `byJobUrls` (fetch by URL) |
| `keyword` | string | – | Job title or keyword (mode=search) |
| `location` | string | – | City, state or region to search (mode=search); leave empty for all locations |
| `country` | string | `www` | Which Talent.com country site to search, out of 78 (mode=search) |
| `radiusMiles` | integer | `25` | Search radius in miles, 5–100 (mode=search) |
| `sortBy` | string | `relevance` | `relevance` or `date` |
| `datePosted` | string | – | Only jobs posted in the last 1/3/7/14 days |
| `jobType` | string | – | `full-time`, `part-time`, `permanent`, `temporary` or `internship` |
| `remoteOnly` | boolean | `false` | Only remote/work-from-home jobs |
| `quickApplyOnly` | boolean | `false` | Only jobs supporting Talent.com's one-click Quick Apply |
| `jobUrls` | array | – | Talent.com job URLs to fetch (mode=byJobUrls) |
| `maxItems` | integer | `50` | Maximum number of job records to return (1–1000) |
| `maxPages` | integer | `5` | Maximum search-result pages to crawl, ~20 jobs per page (mode=search) |
| `proxyConfiguration` | object | `{"useApifyProxy": true}` | Used automatically only if Talent.com starts blocking requests |

### Example: search in the United States

```json
{
  "mode": "search",
  "keyword": "software engineer",
  "location": "New York, NY",
  "radiusMiles": 25,
  "maxItems": 50,
  "maxPages": 5
}
```

### Example: search a non-US country site

```json
{
  "mode": "search",
  "keyword": "nurse",
  "location": "London",
  "country": "uk",
  "maxItems": 50,
  "maxPages": 5
}
```

### Example: fetch full detail for specific jobs

```json
{
  "mode": "byJobUrls",
  "jobUrls": ["https://www.talent.com/view?id=630921865107343938"]
}
```

## Use cases

- **Job boards and aggregators** — refresh their own listings from Talent.com's current postings
- **Recruiting and sourcing teams** — monitor new postings for a target company or role across countries
- **Labour-market research** — track hiring volume, salary ranges and job types by location
- **B2B lead generation** — identify companies actively hiring to prioritize outreach
- **Niche career sites** — build a location- or keyword-specific job feed
- **Competitive intelligence** — see which roles a competitor is actively hiring for and where

## FAQ

**Is this affiliated with Talent.com?**
No. This is an independent actor that reads Talent.com's publicly available search and job pages; it is not operated by or affiliated with Talent.com.

**Why does the `country` field matter so much?**
Talent.com runs a genuinely separate site per country. Leaving `country` at its United States default and typing a foreign city into `location` (e.g. "London") can silently match a same-named US town instead of the country you meant — set `country` to match the site you actually want searched.

**Why are some fields missing from a record?**
Talent.com doesn't display every field for every job; only fields it actually shows are included, never a null or placeholder value.

**Are salary and posting time available on every country site?**
`title`, `company`, `location` and `jobUrl` are reliable everywhere. `salary`, `employmentType` and `postedAgo` are parsed from English-language badge text, so they populate reliably on English-speaking country sites and are omitted — never guessed — on sites in other languages.

**Why did I get fewer results than `maxItems`?**
Talent.com's own search results are capped per query — most keyword/location combinations expose only a handful of pages before pagination ends, even for broad searches. The actor returns everything Talent.com actually exposes and stops cleanly once it does.

**How do I handle ambiguous city names?**
Add the state or province when a city name is shared with a smaller town elsewhere (e.g. "Montreal, QC" rather than just "Montreal", which is also a town in Wisconsin).

**Do I need an account or API key?**
No — this actor reads Talent.com's public search results and job pages.
